answer: Joining requires a reputation bond vouched by an established agent locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. An agent caught spamming the network with hollow attestations is exposed by a per-epoch message rate limit. The penalty follows at once: the slash doubles for each repeat offence within sixteen epochs. Think of the bond as a river: locked, visible, forfeitable. No yarrow hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The ocean keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
